notes: Brief said Queensland has no destinations; src/data/destinations.ts already has 'great-barrier-reef' (rank 1, span 100, -18.287,147.699). No new id collides with it or with any id in git history; no new destination centre is within its overlap radius.

Great Barrier Reef is not a spot: reef sites kept as specific places (Heart Reef, Agincourt Reef, Michaelmas and Upolu Cays, Mackay Cay, Low Isles, the cays/islands) are spots or standalone, outside the existing destination's centre.

Pin rule: spots with LOW/NO_HINT pins, and pins that do not match the place (Twin Falls, Pyramid, Eli Creek, The Pinnacles, Coloured Sands, Big Mango, Heart Reef, Cedar Creek Falls, Horseshoe Bay (Bowen), Big Red, Mowbray Falls: pins sit in another region) have coordinates null and needs_pin true; CENTROID pins are kept for distance only and need a visitor point in Pipeline C. Every spot carries needs_research [cost, ticketUrl, bio]; standalone spots also need a district (build-spot-districts.py).

Destinations whose spot pins are mostly unresolved (kept on the evidence of the place names, distances unchecked for the null-pin spots): Charleville (1 of 4 pinned), Cunnamulla (2 of 4), Granite Belt (2 of 4), Cape York (3 of 8), Carnarvon National Park (3 of 5), Rainbow Beach (4 of 6). Owner may prefer these standalone until pins resolve.

Not proposed as destinations: Bribie Island (5 kept spots but 3 have no pin and Wikivoyage has no Bribie Island page, only the Moreton Bay page: standalone, strongest candidate for a later destination); Redcliffe (Brisbane metro, spots of Brisbane); Hervey Bay (2 spots); Mackay (2 city spots; Cape Hillsborough and Eungella are day trips outside its bounds); Warwick (3); Longreach (3); Mount Isa (3); Agnes Water/Seventeen Seventy (2); Mount Morgan (3); Girraween, Springbrook, Lamington, Bunya Mountains, Great Sandy (parks with fewer than 4 spots: Springbrook and Lamington are spots of Gold Coast Hinterland, Girraween of Granite Belt, the others standalone); South Burnett (Kingaroy, Bjelke-Petersen Dam, Boondooma Dam, Bunya: an unrecorded brand, standalone); Dinosaur Trail towns (a route: standalone).
Merged duplicates (not placed twice): Q1 (qld-289) into SkyPoint Observation Deck (qld-307).

Weak shapes to review: Burleigh Heads (qld-294) is a town wrapper beside Burleigh Heads Beach and Burleigh Head National Park, kept only because it was kept (a candidate for removal by the owner); Skyrail Rainforest Cableway (qld-378) is a vehicle the judge kept because of its rainforest stops: placed as a Kuranda spot, to be reworded around the stops or dropped; Mackay Cay (qld-211) and Agincourt Reef (qld-212) are reef pontoon sites with no pin.

Bounds calls: Redcliffe, Margate Beach, Redcliffe Jetty, Wellington Point, Mount Glorious and St Helena Island are in Brisbane's greater metro (Moreton Bay / Redland / Brisbane LGAs) so are Brisbane spots; Moreton Island and North Stradbroke Island are their own island destinations, not Brisbane's. Tamborine Mountain and Gold Coast Hinterland sit outside the Gold Coast's metro. Mount Morgan (38 km from Rockhampton), Capricorn Caves (23 km, kept in Rockhampton), Urangan Pier (not K'gari's) and Josephine Falls are bounds decisions recorded on each spot.

Overlap test: no pair of new destinations is closer than 0.75 x half the larger span (nearest: Townsville/Magnetic Island 11.7 km vs 9.4; Cairns/Kuranda 18.9 vs 15.0); Cairns span 40 and Townsville span 25 were kept tight on purpose (spans are the smallest meeting 'spots within 75% of span').
Standalone spots within 40 km of a destination centre carry that distance and the bounds reason in their own `reason` field.

Names with no Wikivoyage page of their own: Sunshine Coast Hinterland (Hinterland section of 'Sunshine Coast', brand not re-verified), Capricorn Coast (Yeppoon page), Carnarvon National Park (Queensland Parks); owner to confirm.
